content.title: 4 Promotional Villas and Network Works
summary: A private residential development of four promotional villas in Rouiba, executed under a comprehensive all-trades package (TCE) including roads and utility networks (VRD).
The project integrates structural concrete works, high-performance building envelopes, and dedicated utility connections to establish a self-contained residential enclave.
description: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction executed the complete construction cycle for this residential development. The scope of works encompassed reinforced concrete structural framing, internal masonry, high-specification interior and exterior finishes, and integrated mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) installations.

To ensure long-term operational durability, the site works included extensive civil engineering for roads and utility networks (VRD). This involved grading, stormwater management, domestic water supply lines, electrical grid connections, and dedicated pedestrian and vehicular access pavements.
content.authority: By managing both the structural execution and the complex civil works under a single all-trades package, the project team maintained strict tolerances from foundation pouring to final envelope sealing.

faq.question: What was the construction scope for the Rouiba villas?
faq.answer: The project was delivered as a complete all-trades package (TCE), covering everything from reinforced concrete foundations and structural framing to interior plastering, MEP installations, and exterior facade finishes.

faq.question: How were the site infrastructure and utility networks managed?
faq.answer: The civil engineering scope included full roads and utility networks (VRD) works, establishing independent connections for water, electricity, and sanitation, alongside paved vehicular and pedestrian access roads.

faq.question: What architectural typology do these residential units follow?
faq.answer: The units are designed as contemporary multi-storey private villas, featuring flat-roof profiles, recessed glazing to manage solar gain, and integrated structural pergolas.
